scripts.build: bun run tsc --noEmit && echo 'Type check passed ✅'
scripts.pre-test: bun run test:check && bun run pre-test:cleanup
scripts.pre-test:check-dir: test -f package.json || (echo '❌ Error: Must run from project root' && exit 1)
scripts.pre-test:cleanup: rm -rf tests/test-area/.logs tests/test-area/.langton-server.lock tests/test-area/notes tests/test-area/typescript_code 2>/dev/null || true
